description.value:
As an action on its own turn, your companion can step into the lead for 1 minute, gaining the following benefits:

  • Temporary hit points equal to twice its level.
  • Once per turn, an extra die rolled whenever it deals damage or restores hit points.
  • Resistance to kinetic and energy damage.

This effect ends early if your companion is incapacitated or killed, and it must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
